title: 8.5 Using Recursive Rules with Sequences

icans: I can find the terms of a sequence from a recursive rule.
I can write recursive rules for sequences.
I can translate between explicit and recursive rules.

vocab: gives aₙ as a ___________ of n
gives the first __________(s) and an equation for aₙ using earlier terms

blocks.p: A pond has 400 fish. Each year, 20% of the fish are caught, and then 100 new fish are added.
Recursive rule: a₁ = ______,  aₙ = ________________      Where are the numbers heading? ________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Recursive rule: A recursive rule gives the _______________ and how to get each term from the _______________.

blocks.stem:
Write the first six terms of each sequence.
a.  a₁ = 2,  aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 5        b.  f(0) = 1,  f(1) = 1,  f(n) = f(n − 1) + f(n − 2)

Write a recursive rule for each sequence.
a.  3, 13, 23, 33, …        b.  16, 40, 100, 250, …

Write a recursive rule for each sequence.
a.  aₙ = −6 + 8n        b.  aₙ = −3(2)ⁿ⁻¹

Write an explicit rule for each sequence.
a.  a₁ = −5,  aₙ = aₙ₋₁ − 2        b.  a₁ = 10,  aₙ = (1/2)aₙ₋₁
Write an explicit rule for a₁ = 12, aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 7.

tickets.stem: Write the first four terms: a₁ = 4,  aₙ = 3aₙ₋₁
Write an explicit rule for the sequence in #2.
